_readme: DEALS AND OFFERS. These show up on the home page and at the top of the menu.
TO RUN A NEW OFFER:  copy a whole { ... } block, paste it, change the words and the price.
TO STOP AN OFFER:    change  "active": true  to  "active": false. It disappears from the site.
(Don't delete it — you'll probably want to run it again.)
TO REORDER:          move the blocks up or down. Top of the list shows first.
"badge" is the little tag on the corner of the card. Leave it as "" for none.
"compareAt" is the normal price, used to show 'Save $x'. Leave it out if there's no saving to show.
"until" is optional. Format YYYY-MM-DD. After that date the deal hides itself automatically.

_slotsReadme: 'slots' describes what the customer still has to choose inside a deal.
type 'pizza'  opens the topping builder. 'size' is the index into
menu.json builder.sizes and is locked. 'included' is how many
toppings the deal price covers; past that they pay per topping.
type 'fixed'  nothing to choose, just listed so they can see what they get.
A deal with no 'slots' is added to the basket in one tap.
